plugins.name: agent-companion
plugins.description: Guardrails and calibration for agent teams: keeps the main thread delegating, caps premium-model fan-out, holds agents to a short reporting contract, watches instruction budget, backs up the memory corpus, and detects harness drift.

plugins.name: write-target-guard
plugins.description: PreToolUse guard on Write|Edit that keeps code writes out of protected worktrees (a primary/deploy checkout and unnamed auto-worktrees). Rules come from a per-machine config file outside any repo, with Windows path-alias hardening (device/UNC prefixes, ADS, 8.3/junctions/symlinks). Fails open and loud if its config is missing or malformed.

description: Agent-team templates, tagged lessons, and the agent-companion and write-target-guard guardrail plugins.
